requirements.trigger: Any core requirement, type, state, dependency, test, fixture, generated artifact, or build output is introduced or changed.
requirements.shall: Admit the semantic only when it maps to an allowed core concept and has an admissible source reference.
requirements.boundary: Prior projects, examples, vendors, domains, assistant preferences, implementer preferences, and v1 behavior are non-authoritative.
requirements.failure: Reject the change before build; do not create a normative artifact.

requirements.trigger: A repository unit contains any prohibited core semantic.
requirements.shall: Delete the unit and rebuild it only if a v2 requirement requires replacement behavior.
requirements.boundary: Renaming, conditional disabling, deprecation, tombstoning in active code, or wrapping the contaminated implementation does not satisfy deletion.
requirements.failure: Mark the unit DELETE_AND_REBUILD and block integration.

requirements.trigger: A binding v2.0.1 contract file is changed.
requirements.shall: Reject mutation and require a new semantic version and new content digest.
requirements.boundary: No in-place correction of a released contract is permitted.
requirements.failure: Fail V-CONTRACT and V-SCOPE.

requirements.trigger: An agent is created, activated, suspended, migrated, or resumed.
requirements.shall: Maintain one durable agent identity independent of activation, model, harness, process, container, and system generation.
requirements.boundary: A cognition backend or harness cannot own or replace the durable identity.
requirements.failure: Block activation or resume from durable identity and last committed state.
requirements.acceptance: agent_id is unchanged across backend replacement and host restart

requirements.trigger: No human session is active.
requirements.shall: Continue admitting wakes, activations, bounded capability use, effect reconciliation, recovery, and completion.
requirements.boundary: Human authority is invoked only by an explicit policy requirement.
requirements.failure: Enter BLOCKED_AUTHORITY only when required authority is absent; do not require login for routine operation.

requirements.trigger: A system image or generation is built.
requirements.shall: Build from locked Nix inputs and emit source, dependency, closure, and output digests.
requirements.boundary: Undeclared nondeterministic inputs are prohibited.
requirements.failure: Reject qualification.

requirements.trigger: A candidate generation boots.
requirements.shall: Confirm only after state, authority, effect recovery, evidence, and required health gates pass.
requirements.boundary: Process start and boot completion are insufficient.
requirements.failure: Exhaust boot attempts and select the last confirmed generation.

requirements.trigger: Bootstrap starts after interruption.
requirements.shall: Recover durable state, fence stale leases, classify nonterminal effects, and restore service readiness in dependency order.
requirements.boundary: Dependent objectives cannot resume before effect classification.
requirements.failure: Remain RECOVERING or FAILED with a typed blocker.

requirements.trigger: A hardware profile is admitted.
requirements.shall: Declare pinned kernel, firmware, drivers, capacity, supported execution profiles, enforceable isolation, and explicit absences.
requirements.boundary: Only canonical generic profile identifiers are allowed in core.
requirements.failure: Reject the profile or reject work requiring an absent feature.

requirements.trigger: A command or state transition is admitted.
requirements.shall: Commit current state and append-only transition history atomically under a stable command identity.
requirements.boundary: History mutation and duplicate semantic execution are prohibited.
requirements.failure: Rollback the transaction and return the original disposition for duplicates.

requirements.trigger: A wake is created or an activation lease changes.
requirements.shall: Persist wake eligibility atomically and use monotonic fencing tokens for leases.
requirements.boundary: Expired or superseded lease holders cannot commit.
requirements.failure: Reject stale fences and requeue eligible work.

requirements.trigger: A schema migration, backup, or restore runs.
requirements.shall: Preserve a consistent transactional state and evidence recovery point with explicit forward, rollback, and interruption behavior.
requirements.boundary: Unknown or rejected records cannot be coerced into v2.
requirements.failure: Rollback migration or quarantine the record; keep v2 inactive.

requirements.trigger: A projection or index answers a query.
requirements.shall: Return source position and freshness and remain non-authoritative.
requirements.boundary: A stale projection cannot represent itself as current truth.
requirements.failure: Return STALE or read authoritative state.

requirements.trigger: An activation invokes the Agent ABI.
requirements.shall: Authenticate the local transport and bind schema version, command, machine, agent, objective, activation, lease fence, generation, activation set, deadline, trace, and evidence references.
requirements.boundary: Missing identity or binding fields are invalid.
requirements.failure: Return INVALID or UNAUTHORIZED without state mutation.

requirements.trigger: A command identity is replayed.
requirements.shall: Return the originally committed disposition.
requirements.boundary: No handler may execute the semantic command twice.
requirements.failure: Return INTERNAL if the ledger is inconsistent and block further execution.

requirements.trigger: A cognition backend or harness is replaced.
requirements.shall: Preserve agent, objective, command, activation, context-request, and effect semantics.
requirements.boundary: Provider transcripts are diagnostic evidence only.
requirements.failure: Return INCOMPATIBLE and leave durable work resumable.

requirements.trigger: A client sends an unknown major version or removed v1 semantic.
requirements.shall: Reject with INCOMPATIBLE or INCOMPATIBLE_DOMAIN_SEMANTICS.
requirements.boundary: Removed semantics cannot be down-mapped.
requirements.failure: No state mutation and no effect admission.

requirements.trigger: An activation lacks information needed for a decision or causal diagnosis.
requirements.shall: Accept a semantic ContextRequest containing unknown, blocked decision, causal hypothesis, freshness need, and evidence type; return a bounded ContextBundle.
requirements.boundary: Context cannot grant authority or assert completion.
requirements.failure: Return explicit MISSING, CONFLICT, STALE, or UNAVAILABLE context status.

requirements.trigger: A context item is admitted to a bundle.
requirements.shall: Bind origin, capture time, effective time, digest, trust classification, freshness state, and source position.
requirements.boundary: Unproven origin is labelled untrusted.
requirements.failure: Exclude the item or return MISSING provenance.

requirements.trigger: Authoritative context inputs contradict.
requirements.shall: Return CONFLICT with both source references.
requirements.boundary: The compiler cannot silently select a winner.
requirements.failure: Block the dependent decision until resolved or explicitly bounded.

requirements.trigger: Repeated failure, changed assumptions, missing evidence, or low-confidence diagnosis is observed.
requirements.shall: Emit a metacognitive context-fault hint while allowing the cognition backend to decide whether to request additional context.
requirements.boundary: No infinite mandatory reasoning process or universal behavior tree is imposed.
requirements.failure: Record the hint and continue only within remaining authority and evidence bounds.

requirements.trigger: A capability invocation or effect is proposed.
requirements.shall: Authenticate the subject and evaluate a current scoped grant at the action boundary.
requirements.boundary: Context, model output, code, package metadata, and possession of credentials are not grants.
requirements.failure: Deny with UNAUTHORIZED.

requirements.trigger: A grant is delegated.
requirements.shall: Only reduce operations, targets, duration, quotas, delegation depth, and generation scope.
requirements.boundary: A child cannot exceed any parent bound.
requirements.failure: Reject without issuing a grant.

requirements.trigger: A grant is revoked or authority state becomes stale or unavailable.
requirements.shall: Prevent new invocation within the configured propagation bound and preserve in-flight history.
requirements.boundary: No new consequential operation may use stale authority.
requirements.failure: Fail closed; reconcile in-flight effects according to their state.

requirements.trigger: A component requests credentials, network, device, storage, or external effect access.
requirements.shall: Mediate access through an explicit generic capability endpoint and Linux enforcement.
requirements.boundary: No ambient credentials or bypass path may exist in activation context or environment.
requirements.failure: Deny and emit an attributed security observation.

requirements.trigger: An operation can change state outside the authoritative transaction or produce consequential output.
requirements.shall: Represent it as a durable Effect before provider dispatch.
requirements.boundary: Cognition and generated code cannot call providers around the effect boundary.
requirements.failure: Deny dispatch.

requirements.trigger: An effect is proposed.
requirements.shall: Atomically evaluate authority, validate preconditions, and reserve a semantic idempotency key before dispatch.
requirements.boundary: An idempotency key identifies intent, not an attempt.
requirements.failure: Reject or return the existing effect.

requirements.trigger: Transport, timeout, or executor loss occurs after dispatch without independent outcome evidence.
requirements.shall: Transition to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and then RECONCILING.
requirements.boundary: Blind retry as a new effect is prohibited.
requirements.failure: Block dependent completion and continue bounded reconciliation.

requirements.trigger: A provider is registered or an effect attempt executes.
requirements.shall: Declare reconciliation mode and record request digest, dispatch time, provider, transport identity, response, observation source, and classification.
requirements.boundary: Admitted class cannot exceed provable reconciliation and evidence behavior.
requirements.failure: Reject provider admission or effect class.

requirements.trigger: Compensation or objective completion is requested.
requirements.shall: Represent compensation as a new independently authorized effect and deny completion while required effects are nonterminal or unknown.
requirements.boundary: Compensation cannot erase original history.
requirements.failure: Keep the objective incomplete and expose the blocking effect.

requirements.trigger: An activation workload starts.
requirements.shall: Create a private workspace, explicit read-only inputs, bounded outputs, resource quotas, and default-deny network.
requirements.boundary: Only canonical generic execution profiles are core.
requirements.failure: Reject activation if the profile cannot enforce declared bounds.

requirements.trigger: An activation is cancelled, expires, crashes, or is terminated.
requirements.shall: Revoke runtime access, fence leases, retain required evidence, and classify dispatched effects independently.
requirements.boundary: Termination cannot assert failure of a dispatched effect.
requirements.failure: Enter recovery and reconciliation.

requirements.trigger: A cognition or harness adapter executes.
requirements.shall: Use the normalized cognition contract and have no direct authority, secret, or external-effect path.
requirements.boundary: Harnesses are adapters, not principal types, execution kinds, or authority planes.
requirements.failure: Deny activation or terminate the adapter.

requirements.trigger: A capability package is submitted.
requirements.shall: Verify immutable digest, signature, provenance, SBOM, dependency closure, requested authority, resources, execution profile, ABI compatibility, state migration, and live verification contract.
requirements.boundary: Package kinds are canonical generic execution profiles only.
requirements.failure: Reject before staging.

requirements.trigger: A package set activates or upgrades.
requirements.shall: Create an immutable digest-addressed activation set and bind activations to it.
requirements.boundary: Silent provider rebinding is prohibited.
requirements.failure: Keep the prior set active or roll back.

requirements.trigger: A package attempts to introduce core semantics.
requirements.shall: Reject additions to principal kinds, effect classes, authority semantics, execution profiles, hardware profiles, or release gates.
requirements.boundary: Packages provide capabilities only.
requirements.failure: Reject and record a scope violation.

requirements.trigger: An agent proposes code, contract, policy, package, model, context policy, or system-generation change.
requirements.shall: Separate proposal, build, evaluation, signing, staging, activation, confirmation, and rollback states and authorities.
requirements.boundary: A candidate cannot widen its authority or modify its evaluator, scope policy, evidence, or threshold.
requirements.failure: Reject or quarantine the candidate.

requirements.trigger: A candidate is built or evaluated.
requirements.shall: Bind source, dependency closure, contract version, tests, evidence, qualification thresholds, and rollback target.
requirements.boundary: Missing binding data blocks signing.
requirements.failure: Remain REJECTED or PROPOSED.

requirements.trigger: A candidate changes any canonical contract file.
requirements.shall: Require a new semantic version, new complete manifest, full dependent regeneration, and all gates.
requirements.boundary: v2.0.1 is immutable.
requirements.failure: Reject in-place mutation.

requirements.trigger: A work packet or release claims completion.
requirements.shall: Require objective live evidence for every applicable gate and protected independent evidence for consequential claims.
requirements.boundary: Compilation, process health, schema validity, mocks, or handwritten evidence cannot prove runtime behavior.
requirements.failure: Mark the packet or release NOT_COMPLETE.

dispositions.reason: Domain work cannot gate core release.
Generic service contains domain-specific class, fields, errors, behavior, and fixtures.
Generic service contains domain-specific authority semantics and tests.
Contaminated actor, scope, and change model.
Domain safety family embedded in core.
Domain release gate embedded in core.
Domain and vendor decisions promoted to core.
Generated output must derive only from v2.
Passing evidence must be produced by v2 qualification.
Build graph contains rejected component and packet outputs.
Dependency lock derives from changed workspace.
Fixtures cannot import application semantics into core behavior.
Every retained semantic requires v2 authority.
No unit is trusted solely because no keyword matched.

retention_predicate.assertion: Every public type, enum value, state, transition, RPC, and service maps to one or more v2 requirement IDs.
Every conditional branch enforces a v2 invariant, boundary, failure, or recovery behavior.
Every dependency is necessary for a v2 requirement and introduces no prohibited core semantic.
Every test uses only canonical core concepts or opaque synthetic fixtures.
Every generated output traces to a v2 canonical source and reproduces byte-for-byte.
All applicable live gates pass after clean rebuild.

verification_gates.pass: booted == true && active_human_session_required == false && identity_reported == true
objective_completed == true && active_human_session_required == false && lost_work_count == 0 && duplicate_effect_count == 0 && independent_evidence_verified == true
